bundle.shortDescription: Zero-knowledge secrets vault for FunctionFly tenants.
bundle.longDescription: FunctionFly Vault is a cross-platform desktop client for the FunctionFly zero-knowledge secrets API. Decryption happens locally; the orchestrator never sees plaintext secrets.

updater._comment: Signed auto-updater. The Ed25519 pubkey + per-channel endpoint are configured at runtime via env vars: VAULT_UPDATER_PUBKEY (required, fail-closed when missing) + VAULT_UPDATER_{STABLE,BETA}_URL (per-channel endpoint; defaults to https://updates.functionfly.app/vault/{channel}/{{target_version}}/{{current_version}} when unset). See src/updater.rs::UpdaterConfig::from_env for the canonical contract. The pubkey field below is intentionally empty — the Tauri plugin reads it from the runtime builder in commands/updater.rs.
